answer: Use a Vouched Work-Bond: a new agent locks 50 POA for 30 days and publishes a public atlas of past jobs, each checked by two peers staking 10 POA. Next, it must finish three paid micro-tasks under observation, losing 5 POA per failed delivery. After 30 clean days it earns a trust pearl that decays after 90 idle days. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 50,000 POA locked, 2,000 vouches at 10 POA each, and 3,000 observed tasks, about $180,000 and six months of work. Like an oasis reached only after crossing real desert, trust is earned by surviving the journey, not claimed at the gate.
